findings.claim: The async functions deleteScheduledEmailReminder and deleteScheduledSMSReminder are called inside forEach loops without await. The call sites include handleCancelBooking.ts, handleNewBooking.ts, bookings.tsx and workflows.tsx. Because of this, reminder cancellation or DB updates may not complete before the request ends, and rejections are lost.
In handleNewBooking.ts the new try/catch wraps a forEach of un-awaited async reminder-deletion calls. As a result, the catch block and its log.error are unreachable.

In deleteScheduledEmailReminder (emailReminderManager.ts), the immediateDelete=true branch cancels the SendGrid scheduled send and then returns. It neither deletes the workflowReminder DB row nor marks it cancelled, which leaves orphaned rows.

deleteScheduledEmailReminder is called with immediateDelete=true on workflow deletion, step deletion and reschedule. This performs direct SendGrid cancellation that bypasses the deferred cancellation flow and is subject to SendGrid's cancelled-batch limit.
Prisma is imported but no longer used in workflows.tsx, which violates unused-imports/no-unused-imports.
In workflows.tsx, PrismaPromise was changed to a value import but is used only as a type, which violates @typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports.

In handleNewBooking.ts, 'import type { App, Credential, EventTypeCustomInput, Prisma }' was folded into a value import even though all four names are used only as types. This violates @typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports.
Line 9 ('Prisma') in the merged import lacks a trailing comma, which violates the prettier trailingComma 'es5' rule.

In scheduleEmailReminders.ts, the new import of Prisma and WorkflowReminder from '@calcom/prisma/client' is a value import of names used only as types. This violates @typescript-eslint/consistent-type-imports.

The cron cancel loop in scheduleEmailReminders.ts wraps all sequential SendGrid cancel calls in a single try/catch. One failed cancel therefore aborts the loop, skips the remaining cancelled reminders, and affects the queued row deletes.

The cancellation query in scheduleEmailReminders.ts does not restrict to scheduled EMAIL reminders. A reminder with a null referenceId, or an SMS reminder, is passed to SendGrid as an invalid batch_id, which causes API errors and prevents its deletion.

Cancellations in the cron are processed after the earlier delete-by-date logic. If the cron runs late, a cancelled reminder can be removed from the DB without a SendGrid cancellation request ever being sent.
The patch uses prisma.workflowReminder.delete where callers previously used deleteMany. delete throws P2025 when the row is already gone.
The SendGrid scheduled_sends cancel request is duplicated in the cron and in emailReminderManager.ts:214-221.
twilio.cancelSMS and the row delete share one try block. If cancelSMS throws, the row is not deleted, whereas the old callers deleted it regardless of the Twilio result.
About 60 lines inside a commented-out block are re-indented with no behaviour change.

Deferred cancellation only sets cancelled=true and relies on the 15-minute cron, which cancels only reminders due within the next hour. A booking cancelled shortly before its reminder's send time, after the last cron pass, still gets the reminder email.
The EMAIL/SMS reminder-deletion dispatch block is duplicated at 7 call sites.
No tests cover the new cancel lifecycle or the reschedule paths.
In WorkflowStepContainer.tsx, the verify button is not disabled while sendVerificationCodeMutation is loading, so multiple verification SMS sends can be triggered.
schema.prisma has no composite index on (cancelled, scheduledDate) for WorkflowReminder.

The boolean immediateDelete parameter makes deleteScheduledEmailReminder do two different jobs. In the immediate path it deletes nothing and relies on an undocumented precondition that the caller cascade-deletes the row.
The new 'cancelled' field on WorkflowReminder is nullable without a default of false, so existing records can have null values.
In WorkflowStepContainer.tsx, verification can be submitted with an empty phone number or empty code.
In WorkflowStepContainer.tsx, the 'Verification code' placeholder and the 'Verify' button label are hardcoded strings that bypass i18n.

coverage: pooled issues; severity and verdict are placeholders
